LanguageData.CC_Settings_BallroomByUse_Tip: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Empire calls any room with a musical instrument a ballroom, unless it has a bed, throne or workbench, so a drum makes a dining room or a temple a ballroom. With this on, a room with an altar of your faith stays a temple, a room with dining tables stays a dining room, and a drum on its own doesn't make a ballroom. A room with a harp, harpsichord or piano and no altar or dining table is still a ballroom, for the titles and balls that need one. Off, the mod's own rule.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_BallroomByUse: A temple or dining room keeps its name with an instrument in it, and a drum alone makes no ballroom.
